gemini.style: Read the following Persian (Farsi) text aloud in natural, everyday spoken Tehrani Persian, like a friendly, energetic YouTuber talking to one viewer: relaxed and conversational, never formal, bookish or newsreader-like. Smile in the voice, let questions sound like real questions, build a little suspense on teasers, keep a lively but unhurried pace. The text carries diacritics (fatha, kasra, damma) on special words: they are authoritative - pronounce those words exactly as marked.
gemini._note: Owner picked Puck (2026-11-27). Gemini guesses homographs wrong without diacritics (read عِلم as عَلَم); with diacritics OK. Every episode is listened back by check_model; beats with wrong words are re-voiced, still wrong -> not published.
gemini._quota_note: Free tier: 10 requests/day PER MODEL (owner key, 2026-11-27). A long video uses ~3 TTS + ~3 check requests.
